ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - VEF factions
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps for Vanilla Expanded Framework's new-faction workflow: select a missing faction, invoke VEF's check, inspect its dialog and ignored state, and temporarily mark a faction as required. Developer tooling; no Defs or scenarios.
Requires Pickle and Vanilla Expanded Framework when staged as a standalone companion. In the aggregate PickleTools bundle, VEF remains optional and scenarios must declare it with @requires.
